summary: Bounded parse-error repair only. Godot's own log pinpointed a real defect: GDScript's indentation-sensitive lambda parsing does not tolerate the pattern I used throughout test_starter_structures.gd -- a multi-line `func(p): <body on indented next line(s)>` immediately followed by a trailing `, <expected_code>)` written at a shallower indent on its own line, inside an Array literal. That produced the observed 'Unindent doesn't match the previous indentation level' at line 243 and aborted the whol
